name: Open Graphite
author: Rocket Apps

sections.description:
Open Graphite gives you control over how your WordPress content appears when shared on social media.

When someone shares one of your pages on platforms like Facebook, the platform automatically selects text and images from the page to generate a preview. The results are often less than ideal, with irrelevant images, poorly formatted text and descriptions that are cut off mid-sentence. This can make your content less appealing and reduce engagement.

Open Graphite solves this by letting you customise the image, title, description and object type displayed when any of your pages are shared on social media. You can create compelling, purpose-built previews without changing or compromising your original page content.

Features

  • Set the homepage title, description, image and object type
  • Customise the Open Graph title, description, image and object type of any post, page or custom post type
  • Automatically ask Facebook to refresh its cache when you publish or update content (requires a Facebook App ID and App Secret)
  • X (Twitter) username and card type
  • Pinterest options (allow, disable rich pins, or deny saving)
  • Enhanced Slack sharing (author name and reading time)
  • Avoid Open Graph conflicts with Yoast SEO and Jetpack
  • Optional image alt, updated time, article dates, author URL and locale tags
  • Choose which post types and user roles can use the Open Graphite metabox
  • Enable excerpts for pages
  • Homepage previews for Facebook, LinkedIn and X
  • Dynamic testing links to the Facebook Debugger, LinkedIn Post Inspector and other testing tools

Open Graphite Pro

Open Graphite Pro adds:

  • Automatic defaults for titles, descriptions, featured images and object types, plus character limits
  • Social previews for individual posts and pages
  • Automatic cropped 1200 x 630 Facebook-ready image size, with an “Open Graph Sizes” tab in the Media Library
  • WooCommerce product and product category support
  • Open Graph quality indicators admin column
  • Priority support

How to use

For the homepage…

  • Go to Settings > Open Graphite
  • Set your homepage image, title, description and object type
  • Choose which post types to enable
  • Save your settings

For posts and pages…

  • Create a new post or page (or edit an existing one)
  • Scroll down to the Open Graphite metabox
  • Enter your desired title, description, image and object type

External services

This plugin can connect to the Facebook Graph API to ask Facebook to refresh its cached copy of your page, so shared links show your latest title, description and image.

This only happens when you have entered a Facebook App ID and App Secret in Settings > Open Graphite > Facebook, and only when a published post is saved. The URL of the post and an app access token made from your App ID and App Secret are sent to https://graph.facebook.com/.

sections.installation:
1) Go to ‘Add New’ plugins in WordPress admin
2) Search for ‘Open Graphite’
3) Click ‘Install Now’ and wait for it to finish installing
4) Click ‘Activate’
sections.faq:
Can I customise how each page or post is previewed when shared on social media?

Yes. Specify the title, description, image and object type manually on each page or post in the Open Graphite metabox.

There appears to be duplicate sets of open graph tags

Any other plugin that inserts Open Graph tags into your website may conflict with Open Graphite. If Yoast SEO or Jetpack is active, Open Graphite can turn off their Open Graph output for you (Settings > Open Graphite).

To test for other conflicts, view the source code of your page and search for og:. Open Graphite’s tags are output between its own Open Graphite Start and Open Graphite End HTML comments.

Facebook isn’t showing the correct information when I share my page or post

Facebook caches the Open Graph data of a page that has previously been shared. There are a couple of solutions.

1) Enter a Facebook App ID and App Secret in the plugin settings. Open Graphite will then ask Facebook to refresh its cache every time you publish or update a post, or…

2) Use the official Facebook Debugger, paste in the URL of your page or post and hit the Debug button, then hit Scrape Again.

Do I need a Facebook App ID?

No. But you will need one (and an App Secret) if you want Open Graphite to refresh Facebook’s cache automatically.

Why can’t I see the Open Graphite metabox?

Make sure the post type is enabled in Settings > Open Graphite > Post Types. If you are not an administrator, an administrator will need to allow your role under Permissions.

Will my current settings be inherited if I upgrade to Pro?

Yes. If you upgrade to Pro all your current configurations will be preserved. Once Pro is active, the free plugin pauses itself and can be deleted.

Where can I get support for this plugin?

Leave a message at the plugin support page.
